---
theme: charmiq:none
---

<style>
  :root {
    --bench: #F1ECDC;
    --edge: #1D1C19;
    --ink: #1D1C19;
    --rim: #1D1C19;
    --stud: rgba(29, 28, 25, 0.075);
    background-color: var(--bench);
  }
  body {
    background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--stud) 0 1.6px, transparent 2px) 0 0 / 18px 18px, var(--bench);
    color: var(--ink);
    min-height: 100%;
    padding: 30px 20px 28px;
  }
  .studio {
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1.75fr) minmax(0px, 1fr);
    margin: 0px auto;
    max-width: 1680px;
  }
  .studio > p {
    line-height: 0;
    margin: 0px;
  }
  .studio > .timeline {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .studio iframe {
    background: var(--bench);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--rim), 0 4px 0 var(--edge), 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root { --bench: #141311; --stud: rgba(255, 253, 242, 0.055); --ink: #ECE6D6; --rim: #4A463C; --edge: #000000; }
  }
</style>

  <p class="scene">
    <iframe-app data-name="scene" height="380px" src="charmiq://../../apps/codemirror-editor" width="100%">
      <app-content name="scene:scene.js">
// The Salon. A gallery after the Louvre's Salon Carré, hung frame to frame: visitors muse
// along the walls, a couple rests on the velvet bench, a copyist works at her easel before
// the Night Watch, and a guard keeps the door. A girl slips away to the east room and
// stands before Seurat's Sunday on La Grande Jatte; the camera pushes in until the
// painting fills the frame and dissolves into it: the riverbank, its people as Seurat
// painted them, and the girl wandering among them. A lady turns her head. Dissolve back
// to the salon, the girl stepping back from the painting, laughing. The salon and the
// riverbank are two sets of one build, the riverbank under its own sky; the paintings are
// pictures Brick Studio ships: ask your Charm to hang one of your own from the Drive
scene({ title: 'The Salon', fps: 24, length: 31.5, floor: { x: -64, z: -8, width: 128, depth: 60 } })

// the beats, in seconds
const INTO = 12, TURN = 22.4, OUT = 24.6, END = 29.5

// .. the salon ......................................................................
const girl = actor('girl', { part: 'figure', color: 'pink', legColor: 'white', face: 'freckles', hat: { part: 'pigtails', color: 'orange' } }).ground()
const sitter = actor('sitter', { part: 'figure', color: 'dark-red', legColor: 'black', face: 'beard', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'dark-gray' } })
const companion = actor('companion', { part: 'figure', color: 'sand-green', legColor: 'dark-blue', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'tan' } })
const copyist = actor('copyist', { part: 'figure', color: 'white', legColor: 'dark-blue', face: 'glasses', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'black' } }).ground()
const gentleman = actor('gentleman', { part: 'figure', color: 'black', legColor: 'dark-gray', face: 'moustache', hat: { part: 'top-hat', color: 'black' } }).ground()
const boy = actor('boy', { part: 'figure', color: 'blue', legColor: 'tan', face: 'grin', hat: { part: 'cap', color: 'red' } }).ground()
const sister = actor('sister', { part: 'figure', color: 'yellow', legColor: 'blue', hat: { part: 'pigtails', color: 'brown' } }).ground()
const guard = actor('guard', { part: 'figure', color: 'dark-blue', legColor: 'dark-blue', face: 'moustache', hat: { part: 'police-hat', color: 'dark-blue' } }).ground()
const salon = [sitter, companion, copyist, gentleman, boy, sister, guard]

// the couple on the bench, facing the Night Watch: turning to each other, his hands on
// his knees and hers pointing it out, their arms never still
sitter.at(0, { x: -3, z: 21, height: 5, yaw: 180, pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 20, rightArm: 20 } })
companion.at(0, { x: 0.5, z: 21, height: 5, yaw: 180, pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 30, rightArm: 10 } })
         .at(1.8, { pose: { rightArm: 10 } }).at(2.6, { pose: { rightArm: 120 } }).at(4.2, { pose: { rightArm: 120 } }).at(5, { pose: { rightArm: 10 } })
sitter.wobble('pose.leftArm', 8, { rate: 0.35 })
sitter.wobble('pose.rightArm', 10, { rate: 0.3 })
companion.wobble('pose.leftArm', 8, { rate: 0.4 })
sitter.look(companion, { from: 6, to: 7.5 })
companion.look(sitter, { from: 6.4, to: 8 })
// the copyist at her easel, her brush arm working, her palette arm shifting
copyist.at(0, { x: 15, z: 33, yaw: 180, pose: { rightArm: 75, leftArm: 20 } })
copyist.wobble('pose.rightArm', 10, { rate: 1.4 })
copyist.wobble('pose.leftArm', 6, { rate: 0.3 })
// a gentleman before the Wedding at Cana, a hand at his chin, looking from one end of it
// to the other
gentleman.at(0, { x: -31, z: 30, yaw: 90, pose: { rightArm: 125, leftArm: -20 } })
gentleman.wobble('pose.head', 40, { rate: 0.45 })
gentleman.wobble('pose.rightArm', 16, { rate: 0.8 })
gentleman.wobble('pose.leftArm', 14, { rate: 0.7 })
gentleman.idle({ energy: 0.7 })/*his weight shifting*/
// two children before the Raft of the Medusa, the boy pointing up at it
boy.at(0, { x: 30, z: 27, yaw: 270, pose: { rightArm: 160, head: -20 } })
boy.wobble('pose.rightArm', 12, { rate: 0.6 })
boy.wobble('pose.leftArm', 10, { rate: 0.5 })
sister.at(0, { x: 30, z: 30, yaw: 270, pose: { head: -15 } })
sister.wobble('pose.leftArm', 10, { rate: 0.45 })
sister.wobble('pose.rightArm', 10, { rate: 0.4 })
sister.look(boy, { from: 3, to: 5 })
// the guard by the east doorway, his hands behind him, watching the girl all the way
// across the hall: his head follows her and his feet turn him a little after her
guard.at(0, { x: 32, z: 16, yaw: 110, pose: { leftArm: -40, rightArm: -40 } })
     .at(5, { yaw: 110 }).at(7.5, { yaw: 130 }).at(9.2, { yaw: 20 }).at(11, { yaw: -50 })/*turning after her once she is by*/
guard.wobble('pose.leftArm', 6, { rate: 0.3 })
guard.wobble('pose.rightArm', 6, { rate: 0.35 })
guard.look(girl, { from: 0, to: INTO, within: 60, max: 80 })

// visitors walking the back wall, stopping at the paintings, looking up at the high ones
const visitors = crowd('visitor', {
  along: [{ x: -32, z: 42 }, { x: 31, z: 42 }], count: 5, width: 6,
  personalities: ['window-shopper', 'tourist', 'stroller', 'tourist', 'stroller'],
  wardrobe: { colors: ['dark-red', 'dark-blue', 'black', 'tan', 'sand-green', 'white', 'dark-green'], legColors: ['black', 'dark-gray', 'tan', 'dark-blue', 'brown'], hats: ['hair', 'pigtails', 'top-hat', 'hair'], faces: ['smile', 'glasses', 'moustache', 'beard', 'lopsided'] },
  stops: [{ x: -29, z: 46 }, { x: -17, z: 46 }, { x: 0, z: 46 }, { x: 13, z: 46 }, { x: 25, z: 46 }],
})
// and the west room's far wall
const westRoom = crowd('viewer', {
  along: [{ x: -57, z: 6 }, { x: -57, z: 42 }], count: 3, width: 3,
  personalities: ['window-shopper', 'tourist', 'stroller'],
  wardrobe: { colors: ['dark-blue', 'tan', 'dark-red'], legColors: ['black', 'tan'], hats: ['hair', 'top-hat'] },
  stops: [{ x: -62, z: 10 }, { x: -62, z: 24 }, { x: -62, z: 36 }],
})
for(const walker of [...visitors, ...westRoom]) walker.ground()/*on the parquet, stepping over its tiles*/
// a visitor along the back wall who stops at six seconds, turns to his right to the
// Night Watch, leans back to take it in, then walks on
const admirer = actor('admirer', { part: 'figure', color: 'dark-green', legColor: 'dark-gray', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'brown' } }).ground()
admirer.at(0, { x: 18, z: 45, yaw: 90 })
       .walk(0, [{ x: 18, z: 45 }, { x: 3, z: 45 }], { until: 6 })
admirer.at(6, { yaw: 90, pose: { lean: 0 } }).at(6.6, { yaw: 180 }).at(6.8, { pose: { lean: 0 } }).at(7.6, { pose: { lean: -10 } }).at(9.4, { pose: { lean: -10 } }).at(9.9, { pose: { lean: 0 } })
       .walk(10, [{ x: 3, z: 45 }, { x: -26, z: 45 }], { until: 24 })
admirer.look({ x: 0, z: 48, height: 30 }, { from: 6.2, to: 9.8, max: 60 })
admirer.wobble('pose.rightArm', 10, { rate: 0.6 })
salon.push(admirer)

// the girl: before the Night Watch, then well behind the bench and off through the east
// doorway to the Grande Jatte, her arms hanging as a walk swings them, back and forth;
// leaning back to take the painting in as the camera pushes in
girl.at(0, { x: -5, z: 32, yaw: 180, face: 'freckles', pose: { leftArm: -31, rightArm: -31, lean: 0 } })
    .walk(5, [{ x: -5, z: 32 }, { x: 22, z: 32 }, { x: 28.5, z: 14 }, { x: 36, z: 10 }, { x: 56, z: 11 }], { until: 10.6 })/*close by the guard, clear of him*/
girl.at(10.6, { yaw: 270 }).at(10.9, { pose: { lean: 0 } }).at(11.7, { pose: { lean: -9 } })
// her footsteps, wherever she steps: soft, on the parquet and the grass alike
girl.footsteps(['footstep-1', 'footstep-2', 'footstep-3'], { volume: 2.5 })

// .. the riverbank, as Seurat painted it: everyone alive as it dissolves in ...............
const lady = actor('lady', { part: 'figure', color: 'black', legColor: 'black', face: 'smile', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'brown' } })
const beau = actor('beau', { part: 'figure', color: 'black', legColor: 'dark-gray', face: 'moustache', hat: { part: 'top-hat', color: 'black' } })
const reader = actor('reader', { part: 'figure', color: 'dark-red', legColor: 'dark-red', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'black' } })
const angler = actor('angler', { part: 'figure', color: 'orange', legColor: 'dark-blue', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'brown' } })
const child = actor('child', { part: 'figure', color: 'white', legColor: 'white', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'tan' } })
const stroller = actor('stroller', { part: 'figure', color: 'medium-blue', legColor: 'medium-blue', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'black' } })
const rower = actor('rower', { part: 'figure', color: 'white', legColor: 'black', hat: { part: 'cap', color: 'white' } })
const nurse = actor('nurse', { part: 'figure', color: 'red', legColor: 'red', hat: { part: 'hair', color: 'dark-gray' } })
// sailboats on the river, swinging to the wind and rocking on the water
const boats = [[96, 48, 0], [124, 58, 90], [77, 44, 0]/*seen behind the reader as the lady turns*/, [170, 44, 0], [230, 60, 90]].map(([x, z, yaw], index) => {
  const boat = actor(`boat-${index + 1}`, { component: 'sailboat' }).at(0, { x: x + 3, z: z + 1, height: 1, yaw })
  boat.wobble('yaw', 7, { rate: 0.12 })
  boat.wobble('roll', 3, { rate: 0.3 })
  boat.wobble('pitch', 2, { rate: 0.25 })
  return boat
})
const painted = [lady, beau, reader, angler, child, stroller, rower, nurse]
// the couple in profile, she composed until she turns; he restless, looking about,
// gesturing, his weight shifting
lady.at(0, { x: 65, z: 0, yaw: 180, pose: { leftArm: 40, rightArm: -20, head: 0 } })
lady.wobble('pose.leftArm', 8, { rate: 0.5 })
lady.wobble('pose.rightArm', 8, { rate: 0.45 })
beau.at(0, { x: 66, z: 3, yaw: 180, pose: { rightArm: 30, leftArm: -20 } })
beau.wobble('pose.head', 45, { rate: 0.45 })
beau.wobble('pose.rightArm', 25, { rate: 0.9 })
beau.wobble('pose.leftArm', 18, { rate: 0.8 })
beau.idle({ energy: 0.8 })
// a woman reading on the grass, an angler at the water, a nurse resting, a rower idling
reader.at(0, { x: 72, z: 22, height: 0, yaw: 180, pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 60, rightArm: 60 } })
reader.wobble('pose.head', 30, { rate: 0.5 })
reader.wobble('pose.leftArm', 18, { rate: 0.8 })
reader.wobble('pose.rightArm', 18, { rate: 0.9 })/*turning the pages*/
angler.at(0, { x: 90, z: 28, yaw: 180, pose: { rightArm: 70, leftArm: 60 } })
angler.wobble('pose.rightArm', 15, { rate: 0.5 })
angler.wobble('pose.leftArm', 10, { rate: 0.4 })
nurse.at(0, { x: 114, z: 2, yaw: 90, height: 0, pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90 } })
nurse.wobble('pose.leftArm', 22, { rate: 0.7 })
nurse.wobble('pose.rightArm', 22, { rate: 0.6 })
nurse.wobble('pose.head', 35, { rate: 0.4 })
rower.at(0, { x: 108, z: 24, yaw: 180, pose: { rightArm: 40 } }).idle({ energy: 0.8 })
rower.wobble('pose.rightArm', 40, { rate: 0.6 })/*waving to the boats*/
rower.wobble('pose.leftArm', 20, { rate: 0.5 })
rower.wobble('pose.head', 40, { rate: 0.35 })
// the girl in white circling slowly, a man strolling along the lawn
child.at(0, { x: 80, z: 6, yaw: 90 })
     .walk(INTO + 0.4, [{ x: 80, z: 6 }, { x: 84, z: 2 }, { x: 88, z: 6 }, { x: 84, z: 10 }, { x: 80, z: 6 }], { until: OUT })
stroller.at(0, { x: 98, z: -8, yaw: 270 }).walk(INTO + 0.9, [{ x: 98, z: -8 }, { x: 118, z: -8 }], { until: OUT })

// the girl in the painting: amazed, looking all about her, then wandering slowly toward
// the couple, stopping to take it in, until the lady turns
girl.at(INTO, { x: 57, z: 11, yaw: 270, face: 'surprised', pose: { head: 0, lean: 0 } }, 'hold')
    .at(13, { pose: { head: -40 } }).at(13.9, { pose: { head: 35 } }).at(14.5, { face: 'grin', pose: { head: 0 } })
    .walk(14.8, [{ x: 57, z: 11 }, { x: 59.5, z: 8 }], { until: 16.8 })
girl.at(17.2, { pose: { head: -45 } }).at(18, { pose: { head: 30 } }).at(18.4, { pose: { head: 0 } })/*the boats, the trees*/
    .walk(18.6, [{ x: 59.5, z: 8 }, { x: 61.5, z: 4.5 }], { until: 20.8 })
girl.at(21, { yaw: 270 })
lady.at(TURN, { pose: { head: 0 } }, 'hold').at(TURN + 0.3, { pose: { head: -55 } }, 'ease-out')
girl.react(TURN + 0.4, 'scared', { for: 1 })
girl.at(TURN + 0.4, { pose: { leftArm: -31, rightArm: -31 } }, 'hold').at(TURN + 1.1, { pose: { leftArm: 110, rightArm: 110 } }, 'ease-in-out')

// .. back in the salon: the girl stepping back from the painting, laughing ..............
girl.at(OUT, { x: 57, z: 11, yaw: 270, face: 'laugh', pose: { leftArm: -10, rightArm: -10, head: 0, lean: 0 } }, 'hold')
    .at(OUT + 0.3, { x: 57 }, 'hold').at(OUT + 2.5, { x: 54.5 }, 'linear')
guard.at(OUT, { x: 39, z: 9, yaw: 270 }, 'hold')/*come to the doorway after her*/
guard.look(girl, { from: OUT + 0.5, to: END + 2, within: 20 })
girl.at(OUT + 2.7, { yaw: 270 }, 'hold').at(OUT + 3.4, { yaw: 0, face: 'grin' })

// who stands in which set: the salon's people out of the painting, the painting's out of the salon
for(const figure of [...salon, ...visitors, ...westRoom]) figure.at(0, { visible: true }).at(INTO, { visible: false }, 'hold').at(OUT, { visible: true }, 'hold')
for(const figure of [...painted, ...boats]) figure.at(0, { visible: false }).at(INTO, { visible: true }, 'hold').at(OUT, { visible: false }, 'hold')
set.at(INTO, 'La Grande Jatte')
set.at(OUT, 'Salon')

// .. the camera .........................................................................
camera.cut(0, { position: { x: 0, z: -70, height: 80 }, target: { x: 0, z: 28, height: 24 } }, 'the salon')
camera.at(5, { position: { x: -2, z: -16, height: 34 }, target: { x: 0, z: 30, height: 18 } })
camera.cut(5, { position: { x: 8, z: 6, height: 12 }, target: { x: -1, z: 40, height: 22 } }, 'musing')
camera.at(8, { position: { x: 4, z: 9, height: 12 }, target: { x: -1, z: 40, height: 24 } })
camera.cut(8, { position: { x: 52, z: 2, height: 10 }, target: { x: 36, z: 10, height: 8 } }, 'the east room')
camera.at(10.4, { position: { x: 52, z: 4, height: 11 }, target: { actor: girl, height: 8 } })
camera.cut(10.4, { position: { x: 28, z: 11, height: 14 }, target: { x: 62, z: 11.5, height: 25 } }, 'the Grande Jatte')
camera.at(INTO, { position: { x: 45, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 }, target: { x: 62, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 } }, 'ease-in')
camera.cut(INTO, { position: { x: 45, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 }, target: { x: 62, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 } }, 'into the painting', { transition: 'dissolve', seconds: 1.5 })
camera.at(13.6, { position: { x: 45, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 }, target: { x: 62, z: 11.5, height: 25.5 } })
camera.at(16, { orbit: { angle: 300, distance: 16, height: 13 }, target: { actor: girl, height: 8 } })
camera.at(TURN - 0.2, { orbit: { angle: 230, distance: 14, height: 11 }, target: { actor: girl, height: 8 } })
camera.cut(TURN - 0.2, { position: { x: 59, z: -7, height: 11 }, target: { x: 64, z: 1, height: 9 } }, 'the lady turns')
camera.cut(OUT, { position: { x: 52, z: -6, height: 12 }, target: { x: 55, z: 11, height: 9 } }, 'back in the salon', { transition: 'dissolve', seconds: 1.2 })
camera.at(END + 2, { position: { x: 51, z: -2, height: 11 }, target: { x: 54, z: 11, height: 9 } })

sound.at(INTO - 0.4, 'whoosh', { volume: 0.4 }).at(OUT - 0.2, 'whoosh', { volume: 0.4 })
sound.at(INTO, 'birds', { volume: 0.8, fadeIn: 1.2, until: OUT + 0.8, fadeOut: 1 })/*the riverbank, through the dissolve back*/
// the gallery's murmur and footsteps under the salon, rising as the camera pushes in and
// giving way to the birds through each dissolve
sound.at(0, 'museum', { volume: 0.25, fadeIn: 5, until: INTO + 0.8, fadeOut: 1.2 }).at(OUT - 0.4, 'museum', { volume: 0.25, fadeIn: 1, until: END + 2 })

fade.out(END, END + 2)
title(END, END + 2, 'The Salon')
      </app-content>

  "config": {

  },

  "tabOrder": [
    "scene"
  ]
}
      </app-state>
    </iframe-app>
  </p>
  <p class="timeline">
    <iframe-app data-name="timeline" height="420px" src="charmiq://." width="100%">
    </iframe-app>
  </p>
</div>
